description.zh: 上游 bundui 的真实组件 newsletter-sections 在本地沙箱中的实际渲染。
description.en: Engage and grow your audience with beautifully designed Tailwind CSS newsletter sections. These layouts combine clean forms, compelling copy, and subtle visuals to encourage sign-ups. Perfect for blogs, SaaS products, and marketing sites looking to build an email list with a modern and conversion-focused approach. Rendered from the original source at commit c07468613dfe7db776f1749a0921a1e5e7bd33d5.
